hero.subtitle: For creator teams. 50K to 200K.
hero.description: Agent, Drive, Notes, and Companion — oxom connects the tools your team uses every day into one controlled system. No tool clutter. No tab switching.

pillars.sectionTitle: Each pillar solves a real problem.
pillars.sectionDescription: No feature bingo. Four modules that together form a seamless creator workflow.

agent.title: Your assistant. Not just a chat window.
agent.description: The Agent lives in your workspace and knows your context. Shorten links, create QR codes, translate text, search domains — using natural language. No tab switching, no copy-paste.

drive.title: One uploads. The other edits.
drive.description: Drive is the shared storage between creator and editor. Thumbnails, raw footage, brand assets — stored centrally, directly editable. No Dropbox link, no WeTransfer.

notes.title: Stream notes. Scripts. Real-time.
notes.description: Timestamps for the editor (please cut from 1:23:45 to 2:34:56), scripts for the next video, sponsorship briefings. All in real-time, everyone in the same document.

companion.title: Your workflow. One tap away.
companion.description: The iOS app is not a stripped-down version — it is a full-featured gateway. Use the Agent, scan and create QR codes, read and write NFC tags. Directly from your phone.

dubNote.title: Dub is deeply integrated — but not a standalone module.
dubNote.description: Link management, QR codes, and analytics run through Dub Pro/Business, controlled by the Agent and the Companion App. No separate dashboard needed.

workflow.sectionTitle: From idea to upload. One flow.
workflow.sectionDescription: No messenger chaos between creator and editor. Your team works in one seamless system.

step1.title: Create a workspace
step1.description: One workspace for your team. Creator, editor, manager — everyone gets access with a clear role.

step2.title: Prepare content
step2.description: Write scripts in Notes, upload assets to Drive, prepare briefings with the Agent. All in one place.

step3.title: Produce and edit
step3.description: Stream timestamps in Notes, raw footage in Drive. The editor knows exactly what goes where — no messenger chaos.

step4.title: Publish
step4.description: Create tracking links via the Agent, generate QR codes for merch, check everything via Companion. Done.

platform.sectionTitle: Calm on the outside. Robust on the inside.
platform.sectionDescription: The interface stays minimal. Underneath: multi-tenant architecture, RLS isolation, NLP agent, and Vercel domain management.

stat3.label: Natural language instead of UI clicks

comparison.sectionDescription: oxom is not a replacement for individual tools — it connects Agent, Drive, Notes, and Companion into one seamless workflow. Your team works in one controlled system, without jumping between subscriptions and tabs.

calculator.sectionTitle: What does it cost for your team?
calculator.sectionDescription: Agency Plan: 4 creators + 1 master workspace flat rate, from the 5th creator +200 €/month (or +2,000 €/year). Calculate your price.

faq.q1: What is included in the Creator Plan?
faq.a1: One workspace with up to 5 team members, 2 TB Drive, oxom Agent, Notes, Dub Pro, Custom Domains, iOS Companion App, and Link in Bio (from beta). One price, everything included.
faq.q2: What is the difference to the Agency Plan?
faq.a2: The Agency Plan includes 4 creator workspaces plus one master workspace for centralized management. Ideal for agencies managing multiple creators. Includes Dub Business, extended storage, and priority support.
faq.q3: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.a3: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time. Billing via Stripe, no lock-in, no minimum contract.
faq.a4: A customizable landing page for your most important links — accessible at creator.oxom.de or your own domain. Currently in development, beta access later this year.
faq.q5: Is there a plan for solo creators?
faq.a5: Not yet as self-serve. For solo creators or newcomers, we offer custom terms. Just reach out.
faq.moreQuestions: Still have questions? We are happy to help.

about.title: About the oxom Project
about.description: oxom is a workspace for creators and editors: a place where you work together — no tab chaos, no scattered links, no 'just send it to me on Slack.'
about.whatP1: The Agent understands natural language and gets things done in the workspace: shorten links, create QR codes, translate, check domains, read text aloud. Drive keeps thumbnails, raw footage, and brand assets in one place — for everyone on the team. Notes bring stream notes, scripts, and briefings into a shared, real-time document.
about.whatP2: Everything is built on the idea that creators and editors share the same context and can do the right thing with just a few clicks — or by voice. The iOS app (Companion) puts Agent, QR, and NFC right in your pocket.
about.whatP3: oxom was born from practice: for people who make videos, edit streams, and want less tool juggling and more focus on the content.

safety.title: Cybersecurity at oxom
safety.description: This page helps you reliably identify official oxom communications and stop phishing early.

checkDomain.title: Check website domain
checkDomain.detail: Official oxom websites end with *.oxom.de, e.g. www.oxom.de or about.oxom.de.

checkEmail.title: Check email sender
checkEmail.detail: Official oxom emails end with @*.oxom.de. Unfamiliar domains are a warning sign.

checkHttps.title: Always use HTTPS
checkHttps.detail: Only enter sensitive data on pages with https:// and verify the URL before every login.

phishingSignals: Urgency or pressure: 'Log in immediately' or 'Your account will be locked today.'
Misspelled domain names or unusual TLDs.
Unexpected file attachments or login links in emails/DMs.
Requests to share codes, passwords, or payment information.
safety.suspicionDescription: Please report suspicious emails, links, or screenshots to {email}.
